stem: A newly received cutting lot has unresolved pathogen status. What is the best biosecurity action?
choices: Mix it with established clean stock to compare vigor.
Maintain identity and controlled separation while the approved acceptance/testing criteria are resolved.
Remove labels so staff are not biased.
Release it if no symptoms appear after one day.
rationale: Incoming material with unresolved status should retain identity and separation until defined acceptance/release criteria are met.
